# stet WebAssembly notices

The bundled runtime is built from [stet](https://github.com/AndyCappDev/stet) v0.8.1 and is distributed under Apache-2.0 OR MIT. Complete license texts are included as `LICENSE-APACHE` and `LICENSE-MIT`.

The WebAssembly binary contains the fonts, encodings, color profile and other resources shipped by the upstream stet source tree. Anyfile does not patch or replace those resources. Their notices and copyright strings remain embedded in the generated binary; corresponding source is available from the exact archive recorded in `SOURCE.md`.
